data.name: AION C IDE with ERA native and Z80 cross-compilers
features: shared portability libraries/templates for Aurelia and Artemis
support for adapting applications to a multitasking C environment
Native ERA and cross Z80 backends
Isolated target libraries and startup code
Named build profiles and separate output directories
Regression profiles for 40-column, 80-column and monochrome displays
data.description: Artemis-hosted multi-target IDE. Produces native ERA/AIONix programs and Z80/enhanced-CP/M binaries for Aurelia and Aurelia+ from shared application projects.

toolchain.target_isolation: A Z80 build cannot link AIONix-only services or host libraries. Each target uses its own assembler/linker, startup code and runtime.
development_workflow: Compile and link with target libraries
Package target disk or cartridge image
Run target conformance and application regression tests
toolchain.optional_status: Optional tools are not guaranteed launch components.
